pull.title: Fix test-slot deploy packaging to include `bmi_logic.py`
pull.body:
The `deploy` job failed during packaged runtime validation because `dist/app.py` imports `bmi_logic`, but the workflow did not copy `bmi_logic.py` into the deployment artifact. This change aligns artifact contents with the app’s module graph so the import check can pass.

- **Root cause**
  - Packaging step copied `app.py`, `serve.py`, and `web.config`, but omitted `bmi_logic.py`.
  - Runtime import gate (`python.exe -c 'import flask, waitress, app'`) then failed with `ModuleNotFoundError: bmi_logic`.

- **Workflow change**
  - Updated `.github/workflows/deploy-azure-test.yml` in `Package Windows Python app`:
    - Added `bmi_logic.py` to the `Copy-Item ... dist\` file list.

- **Net effect**
  - Deployment artifact now contains the split business-logic module required by `app.py`.
  - Keeps current packaging model intact; only module inclusion changed.

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy-azure-test.yml
- Copy-Item app.py, serve.py, web.config dist\
+ Copy-Item app.py, bmi_logic.py, serve.py, web.config dist\
```
